question: Estimate the daily active users (DAU) of a major meditation app in India (e.g., Calm or Headspace or local Wysa).
idealClarificationQuestions: Pick the leading app with India focus or international leader? Use a leading meditation/mental-wellness app like Wysa or Calm.
DAU defined as opened the app or completed a session? Opened the app at least once.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Top-down: total mental wellness app market → leader's market share → MAU → MAU-to-DAU stickiness ratio.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Indian smartphone users open to wellness apps (urban, college+ educated, age 18-45): ~80M.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: MAU (active in last 30 days): ~25-30% of installed = ~3M.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: DAU/MAU ratio for meditation apps (low — episodic use, not daily habit): ~10-15%.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Of these, ever installed a meditation/wellness app
App leader (e.g., Wysa or Calm with India focus) market share

calculationFlow: Indian smartphone users open to wellness apps (urban, college+ educated, age 18-45): ~80M.
Of these, ever installed a meditation/wellness app: ~12% = ~10M.
MAU (active in last 30 days): ~25-30% of installed = ~3M.
App leader (e.g., Wysa or Calm with India focus) market share: ~25% = ~750K MAU.
